exposure: Cesarean section due to breech presentation (control group)
Cesarean section due to placenta accreta spectrum disorder
B7-H4 immunoreactivity in placental and decidual tissue
outcome: Levels of B7-H4 immunoreactivity in placental chorionic villous and decidual basalis tissue
cohort: 49 women who delivered at Bielanski Hospital in Warsaw between 2009 and 2015, with 15 developing postpartum depression, 14 diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum, and 20 healthy controls undergoing cesarean section due to breech presentation.
finding: The highest levels of B7-H4 immunoreactivity were found in placental and decidual tissue samples of women who later developed postpartum depression, while the lowest levels were found in those with placenta accreta spectrum disorder.
